card.name: Exploitation and unfair gain contexts
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation just before or inside passages about exploiting, cheating or defrauding people, such as overcharging, restoring what was taken, or selling indulgences. It is mostly a spot where an exploitation word could come next.

modes.label: Overcharging and fraud
modes.description: Verbs or small words inside accounts of cheating or overcharging people.
modes.example: mill owners who frequently<< charged>> more for goods than stores outside the mill

modes.label: Restitution and debt

modes.label: Abuse of church practice
modes.description: Linking words before a description of a corrupt practice such as selling indulgences.
